propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded via built-in local_to_jira_status and jira_to_local_status; it must become config-driven via per-project overlays loaded from repo_root mapping_config
Unmapped local statuses should drift (omit status field in Jira mutation) with a deduped alert, never coerce or fail
Config remaps and status collapses must round-trip losslessly via rebar-status:<local> labels, recoverable inbound without reverse-map lookup
The outbound seam must resolve per-project status maps from repo_root and thread them through CREATE and UPDATE mappers to both Cloud and DataCenter adapters
Fetcher known-set and preflight_status_mapping must tolerate config-declared Jira status names absent from built-in keys, avoiding spurious warnings
The rebar-status label recovery logic must consolidate duplicate literals into a single derived vocabulary helper covering every local status the stamp rule can emit
